ranking.notes: Unchanged from baseline: dequantize-then-oneMKL-GEMM path used unconditionally for all n (the fused fast-path optimization was trialed and then reverted in this optimize phase -- see optimization/mmvq.json regression_found_in_done_phase). Still the dominant op by wall-clock share.

Split-KV optimization kept (15.02x/7.56x/3.85x for nsplit=16/8/4 on the isolated kernel benchmark). Wall-clock share slightly up vs baseline (18.27% vs 17.17%) only because MUL_MAT+MUL's absolute time changed the denominator; the optimization is independently verified via its own kernel-level bench evidence, not by this ranking.
Elementwise broadcast multiply (RMSNorm weight scale, SwiGLU gate, etc). Unchanged.

Host-round-trip removal kept (device-side gather, no host sync). Wall-clock share dropped from 0.54% baseline-equivalent share (its own optimization is on absolute per-token latency, not visible as a wall-clock-pct drop here since the sync-forced ranking harness bounds every op's own cost by construction -- see method note); confirmed independently via getrows kernel-level bench evidence and via the real (non-profiled) e2e Generation throughput gain.

notes: mmvq's fused fast-path optimization was trialed and reverted during this optimize/done cycle (see optimization/mmvq.json). The e2e ranking share is materially unchanged from baseline for MUL_MAT because the shipped code path (dequant+oneMKL GEMM) IS the baseline path. The real, uninstrumented (non-profiled) e2e wall-clock throughput -- the number that actually matters -- improved from Prompt 622.7/Generation 71.9 t/s (baseline) to Prompt 635.8-653.5/Generation 77.6 t/s (final), driven entirely by the getrows and flash-attn-vec kernel optimizations. See e2e-final-20260907T014143Z-32ca2d (uninstrumented) for that measurement.
